description: List the members of a community. Returns bare user IDs unless you ask for fields, in which case it returns profiles. Many communities hide their member list, which comes back as an access error rather than an empty list.

fields.description: Additional profile fields to return (e.g. photo_200,online,sex,city)

filter.description: Filter: managers, editors, mods, advertisers, friends, unsure

group_id.description: Community ID or its short name (e.g. apiclub). Positive and without the minus sign — the minus belongs to owner_id on a wall, not here.

sort.description: Sort order: id_asc, id_desc, time_asc, time_desc

name: vk_groups_get_members

count.description: Total number of matches on VK, which is usually larger than the returned page

items.description: Member IDs, or profiles when fields are requested

pagination.description: Where this page sits in the whole result. Call the tool again with offset set to next_offset to continue; when next_offset is null there is nothing left to fetch.

next_from.description: Cursor for the next page, on the tools that page by cursor rather than offset

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page, or null when this page is the last one

offset.description: The offset this page started at

returned.description: How many came back on this page

total.description: How many matches VK has in total

title: List community members
